-v: Shows more detail about the connection
-l: Listens for incoming connections on this machine — opens a door that something else could connect into
-e: Connects a program's input/output straight to the network — used to build shells; very high risk, gives real control of the machine to whoever connects
-w: How long to wait before giving up on the connection
-z: Just checks whether the port is open — doesn't send or receive any real data
